@@ -30,6 +30,7 @@
 
 ### Bug Fixes
 
+* Fixed `rda` ignoring `sample_ids`, `feature_ids` and `constraint_ids`. The parameters now label unlabelled tables, override existing labels, and reject a mismatched ID count, matching `cca` ([#2571](https://github.com/scikit-bio/scikit-bio/issues/2571)). Thank @Arthur031221 for reporting.
 * Fixed gzip readers inferring write mode from read/write file objects on Python 3.15 by explicitly opening in binary read mode ([#2577](https://github.com/scikit-bio/scikit-bio/pull/2577)). Thanks to Maximiliano Curia, Andreas Tille and @ChristaCode.
 * Fixed `permdisp` with `test="median"` raising `ZeroDivisionError` when every sample in a group sits on the same ordination point, which happens with technical replicates or any distance matrix containing mutually identical samples. The geometric median kernel normalized its weights by their total before testing whether every point had already converged onto the current estimate, and that total is zero in exactly that case. The test now happens first and the coincident point is returned, which is the median. `test="centroid"` was unaffected, as it does not use the geometric median ([#2574](https://github.com/scikit-bio/scikit-bio/pull/2574)).
 * Fixed `GrammaredSequence.to_definites` raising `TypeError: 'NoneType' object is not subscriptable` on any sequence type that defines no non-canonical characters, which includes `DNA` and `RNA`. The cached mask builder `_degen_nonca_hash` assigned to `_canonical_hash` instead of itself in that branch, so it always returned `None` and additionally overwrote the canonical-character mask with the degenerate-character mask ([#2562](https://github.com/scikit-bio/scikit-bio/pull/2562)).

+class TestRDAIdentifiers(TestCase):
+    def setUp(self):
+        self.y = np.array(
+            [
+                [10.0, 2.0, 5.0],
+                [3.0, 8.0, 1.0],
+                [6.0, 4.0, 9.0],
+                [1.0, 7.0, 2.0],
+                [8.0, 3.0, 6.0],
+            ]
+        )
+        self.x = np.array(
+            [
+                [1.0, 0.5],
+                [0.0, 1.5],
+                [1.0, 2.5],
+                [0.0, 3.5],
+                [1.0, 4.5],
+            ]
+        )
+        self.sample_ids = ["S1", "S2", "S3", "S4", "S5"]
+        self.feature_ids = ["F1", "F2", "F3"]
+        self.constraint_ids = ["pH", "depth"]
+
+    def test_numpy_ids(self):
+        res = rda(
+            self.y,
+            self.x,
+            sample_ids=self.sample_ids,
+            feature_ids=self.feature_ids,
+            constraint_ids=self.constraint_ids,
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(list(res.samples.index), self.sample_ids)
+        self.assertEqual(list(res.features.index), self.feature_ids)
+        self.assertEqual(list(res.biplot_scores.index), self.constraint_ids)
+        self.assertEqual(list(res.sample_ids), self.sample_ids)
+        self.assertEqual(list(res.feature_ids), self.feature_ids)
+        self.assertEqual(list(res.constraint_ids), self.constraint_ids)
+
+    def test_dataframe_ids_override(self):
+        ydf = pd.DataFrame(
+            self.y, index=["a", "b", "c", "d", "e"], columns=["u", "v", "w"]
+        )
+        xdf = pd.DataFrame(self.x, index=["a", "b", "c", "d", "e"], columns=["m", "n"])
+        res = rda(
+            ydf,
+            xdf,
+            sample_ids=self.sample_ids,
+            feature_ids=self.feature_ids,
+            constraint_ids=self.constraint_ids,
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(list(res.samples.index), self.sample_ids)
+        self.assertEqual(list(res.features.index), self.feature_ids)
+        self.assertEqual(list(res.biplot_scores.index), self.constraint_ids)
+        self.assertEqual(list(res.sample_ids), self.sample_ids)
+        self.assertEqual(list(res.feature_ids), self.feature_ids)
+        self.assertEqual(list(res.constraint_ids), self.constraint_ids)
+
+    def test_sample_ids_length_mismatch(self):
+        with self.assertRaisesRegex(
+            ValueError,
+            "Input table has 5 samples whereas 2 sample IDs were provided.",
+        ):
+            rda(self.y, self.x, sample_ids=["only", "two"])
